fichas.title: Laboratory planning and structure
fichas.summary: Laboratories are arranged in three-block facilities with large internal zones. Structural grids support mostly column-free rooms, while partitions, suspended ceilings, and service layouts allow flexibility. Design guidance also covers finishes, isotope laboratory safety, weighing rooms, and service floors.

fichas.title: Analytical physics laboratory building
fichas.summary: The illustrated BASF Ludwigshafen laboratory building organizes laboratories, preparation, evaluation, measurement rooms, and service areas around a central circulation and services zone.

fichas.title: Adaptable multi-purpose institute and service ducts
fichas.summary: The typical floor plan illustrates an adaptable multi-purpose institute organized around a central zone. Related drawings show a laboratory section with a central corridor and accessible main pipe ducts whose cross-section varies with the number of pipes.
